claim: Promoter and splice labels are decodable from DNABERT-2 residual states
required_evidence: Strong residual readout plus controls against trivial artifacts
observed_result: Layer-11 AUROC range 0.8847-0.9383; random-label and position controls near chance
limitation: Promoter tasks remain close to strong GC and k-mer baselines

claim: Splice residual decodability is not explained by GC alone
required_evidence: Matched and shifted GC controls should preserve the readout advantage
observed_result: Splice probes remain about 0.25 AUROC above GC-only matched controls
interpretation: Stronger evidence for non-composition residual signal on splice tasks
limitation: Still a probe result and not a localized circuit

claim: Promoter-TATA patching identifies task-specific causal signal
required_evidence: Head-level patching should restore a corrupted scalar target across many pairs
observed_result: Best mean PM = 1.4029 over 327 usable pairs
interpretation: A head can causally amplify the promoter-TATA readout under patching
limitation: Over-restoration and probe geometry prevent a simple full-recovery claim

claim: Splice-donor patching does not identify a threshold-crossing causal head in the full rerun
required_evidence: Patching should restore a corrupted splice-donor scalar target
observed_result: Best mean PM = 0.1657 over 13,303 usable pairs
interpretation: The splice-donor intervention is weak despite strong residual decodability
limitation: Effect is small on average and not tied to QK/enrichment motif evidence

claim: DNABERT-2 has a strict CTCF motif-detector head
required_evidence: One head should pass QK/motif ranking and motif-local enrichment before causal promotion
observed_result: Best QK r = 0.3004; best rho_h = 1.3130; no passing candidate
interpretation: The strict single-head CTCF detector claim is not supported
limitation: Negative result is scoped to selected model motif scorer data and thresholds

claim: Relaxed CTCF thresholds do not rescue the strict claim
required_evidence: Sensitivity sweep should reveal whether conclusions depend on registered cutoffs
observed_result: No joint QK/enrichment pass once r >= 0.2 even at rho_h >= 1.1
interpretation: The negative CTCF conclusion is not an artifact of one conservative cutoff
limitation: Motif-shuffle and GC-matched nulls require raw artifacts not currently persisted

claim: SAE and OV audits do not reveal a simple alternate CTCF circuit
required_evidence: Output-write or sparse features should align strongly with the biological target
observed_result: TATA OV cosine 0.1261; CTCF SAE best cosine 0.1092
interpretation: Auxiliary audits remain consistent with a distributed or absent simple motif circuit
limitation: Audits are not exhaustive circuit discovery
